The '''Marauder assault armor''' was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] created by the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]] from the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. It offered a high degree of protection against kinetic damage but lesser protection from energy-based weapons like [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. This armor was usually made up of any available moldable materials that may have some protective traits. Hence, its effectiveness could vary greatly, depending on the type of materials used and the skills of the [[armorsmith]]. A typical complete armor set comprised helmet, chest plate, left & right biceps, left & right bracers, gloves, leggings and boots. It was available in several different colors. Two other models of Marauder armors also existed: the [[Marauder Battle Armor|Marauder battle armor]] and the [[Marauder Reconnaissance Armor|Marauder recon armor]]. In addition to the Sanyassan Marauders on Endor, Marauder armors were worn by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:GU5" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a trader encountered the Sanyassan Marauder armorsmith [[Macchbraus]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Macchbraus requested the trader to craft him [[Bone armor|bone]], [[Composite armor|composite]], [[Mabari armor|Mabari]] and [[Padded armor/Legends|padded armor]]s in exchange for teaching him to create Marauder recon and assault armors.<ref name="SWG:GU5" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Marauder assault armor appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Initially, the Marauder assault armor was only worn by Marauder non-player characters in the original release of the game.<ref name="SWG" /> The armor was later made craftable and wearable by players with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 5|Game Update 5]]," on [[July 29]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 5">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67876&month=072008|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 5}}</ref>
